title: Your BlaBlaLink Accounts
needPrimary: You need to link a primary account first with `/blabla-link`.
limitReached: You've reached the alt account limit ({{max}}) for your {{tier}} tier.
chooseMethod:
**Link Alt — {{label}}**

Choose how you want to link your alternate BlaBlaLink account:

**By User ID** — Enter their BlaBlaLink user ID and verify via [profile signature]({{url}}).
**By Cookie** — Paste their browser cookies from BlaBlaLink.
fetchFailed: Could not fetch that profile. Please try again.
phraseNotFound:
The phrase wasn't found in that account's BlaBlaLink signature yet.
Wait 1-2 minutes and click the button again.
altLinked:
✅ Alt account **{{label}}** ({{username}}) has been linked!

You can now use the `account` option on commands like `/profile` and `/characters` to switch between accounts.
Use `/blabla-alts default {{label}}` to set this as your default.
invalidUserId: Invalid user ID. Please enter the numeric ID from their BlaBlaLink profile.
noProfile: Couldn't find a BlaBlaLink profile with that User ID.
fetchProfileFailed: Found the account but couldn't fetch its profile. Try again later.
verifyFound:
✅ Found **{{username}}**!

To verify you own **{{username}}**, put this phrase in their [BlaBlaLink signature]({{url}}), then click check:
**{{phrase}}**

_This verification will expire <t:{{expiry}}:R>._
bothRequired: Both User ID and Auth Token are required.
invalidCredentials: Could not validate these credentials. Make sure the values are correct and you're still logged in on BlaBlaLink.
altCookieLinked:
✅ Alt account **{{label}}** ({{username}}) linked with cookie!

The cookie will be used automatically when this alt is the target.
Use `/blabla-alts default {{label}}` to set this as your default.
